the increase in GLUT1 expression in response to azides is mediated by a change in the cell SH/SS redox state.

the regulation of the GLUT1 glucose transporter in response to alterations in cell energy state.
the mechanisms by which cells adapt to changes in the environment.
the regulation of glucose transporters and glucose transport in the liver and other tissues.

an increase in cytosolic SH/SS ratio is a critical determinant of GLUT1 mRNA expression in response to oxidative stress.
